constructionSection.description: Space Field bridges the gap between the construction site and the boardroom. Eliminate paperwork, reduce rework, and deliver projects on schedule with our specialized construction module.

item1.title: Real-Time Site Progress
item1.desc: Track daily logs, labor hours, and material usage instantly. Keep stakeholders aligned with live updates from the ground.

item2.title: Digital QC & Safety Inspections
item2.desc: Digitize your snag lists and safety audits. Capture photos, annotate issues, and assign fixes directly to subcontractors.

item3.title: Fleet & Asset Management
item3.desc: Monitor heavy equipment usage and location. Prevent theft and optimize deployment schedules to reduce downtime.

constructionSection.imageAlt: Construction Site Management with Space Field

hvacSection.description: Space Field helps HVAC and plumbing businesses dispatch faster and fix smarter. Manage recurring maintenance contracts, track parts inventory, and invoice customers right from the job site.

item1.title: Service Call Dispatching
item1.desc: Assign jobs to the nearest technician with the right skills. Track job status from 'En Route' to 'Completed' in real-time.

item2.title: Equipment History & Audits
item2.desc: Access detailed service history for every HVAC unit. Scan QR codes to instantly retrieve manuals, warranty info, and past repair logs.

item3.title: Plumbing Inspection Reports
item3.desc: Generate professional inspection reports on-site. Capture photos of leaks or piping issues and get customer sign-off digitally.

coreFunctions.description: Space Capture includes all the powerful field data tools you need at an enterprise scale. Create professional, intelligent forms using our extensive list of modules, smart logic, and deep branding options.

visualFormBuilder.title: Visual Form Builder
visualFormBuilder.desc: Drag-and-drop interface to create complex data collection forms in minutes. No coding required.

aiDetection.title: AI Detection Analysis
aiDetection.desc: Automatically analyze survey images to detect defects, classify assets, and auto-generate field reports.

engagementFlows.title: Engagement Flows
engagementFlows.desc: Design automated workflows that trigger based on user inputs, location, or time-based events.

accessControl.title: Access Control
accessControl.desc: Granular permission settings to ensure the right team members access only what they need.

deepInsights.title: Deep Insights
deepInsights.desc: Turn raw field data into actionable intelligence with real-time analytics and exportable reports.

logistics.description: Space Field transforms logistics operations with end-to-end visibility. From the warehouse dock to the customer's doorstep, ensure every mile is optimized and every delivery is verified.

fleetTracking.title: Fleet Tracking & Telematics
fleetTracking.desc: Monitor vehicle locations, fuel usage, and driver behavior in real-time. Reduce idle time and optimize routes to save on operational costs.

pod.title: Proof of Delivery (POD)
pod.desc: Capture digital signatures, photos, and timestamps at every drop-off. Automatically update order status and trigger customer notifications.

routeOptimization.title: Dynamic Route Optimization
routeOptimization.desc: Plan the most efficient delivery sequences instantly. Adjust routes on the fly based on traffic, weather, or urgent pick-up requests.

utilities.description: Space Field modernizes utility operations. From routine line maintenance to emergency storm response, ensure your infrastructure stays resilient and your workforce stays safe.
utilities.imageAlt: Utility Field Operations and Grid Maintenance

gridMaintenance.title: Grid Maintenance & Inspections
gridMaintenance.desc: Digitize substation inspections and line patrols. Capture thermal imagery and equipment readings directly in the field to prevent failures.

smartMeter.title: Smart Meter Deployment
smartMeter.desc: Streamline rollout projects for smart infrastructure. Track installation progress, verify connectivity, and manage inventory in real-time.

outageResponse.title: Outage Response & Dispatch
outageResponse.desc: Coordinate storm response teams instantly. Visualize outages on a live map and dispatch the nearest qualified crew to restore power faster.

oilGas.description: Space Field delivers robust digital solutions for the demanding environments of the energy sector. Streamline inspections, ensure crew safety, and maintain asset integrity from the field to the control room.
oilGas.imageAlt: Oil and Gas Field Operations with Space Field

hse.title: HSE & Safety Compliance
hse.desc: Enforce rigorous safety protocols on rigs and refineries. Digital permit-to-work systems and hazard reporting ensure 100% compliance with industry standards.

assetIntegrity.title: Asset Integrity Management

remoteOps.title: Remote Field Operations
remoteOps.desc: Keep upstream and downstream teams connected. Offline capabilities allow technicians in remote fields to log data without interruption.

manufacturing.description: Space Field streamlines manufacturing logistics and maintenance. Empower your workforce with mobile tools to track assets, report hazards, and ensure production targets are met safely.

maintenance.title: Equipment Maintenance & Repairs
maintenance.desc: Shift from reactive to preventive maintenance. Schedule automated work orders for machinery service to minimize costly downtime.

qualityControl.title: Production Line Quality Control
qualityControl.desc: Digitize QA inspections on the factory floor. Capture defect data instantly and generate compliance reports for ISO standards.

shopFloor.title: Real-Time Shop Floor Visibility
shopFloor.desc: Monitor workflow status and labor allocation in real-time. Connect floor supervisors with management for faster decision-making.

telecom.description: Space Field empowers telecom operators to manage vast infrastructure networks with ease. From tower climbs to fiber splicing, keep your field teams synced and your network online.

rollout.title: Network Rollout & Maintenance
rollout.desc: Accelerate fiber and 5G deployment. Manage site surveys, installation tracking, and preventative maintenance schedules in real-time.

audits.title: Tower & Infrastructure Audits
audits.desc: Conduct rigorous structural inspections. Capture geotagged evidence of tower conditions and automate compliance reporting.

dispatch.title: Field Technician Dispatch
dispatch.desc: Optimize route planning for widespread teams. Reduce response times for outages and ensure the right tech arrives with the right parts.

facility.description: Space Field unifies facility operations into one intuitive platform. Empower your teams to manage maintenance, assets, and tenant satisfaction from anywhere in the building.

workOrder.title: Work Order Management
workOrder.desc: Streamline tenant requests and internal repairs. Assign tasks to maintenance staff instantly and track resolution times to ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are met.

preventive.title: Preventive Maintenance

assetTracking.title: Space & Asset Tracking
